{
  "name": "cc-grammar",
  "version": "2.0.6",
  "description": "English while you write a prompt, for your eyes only. After a pause, the English of your draft shows in gray after it: translated from any language, or your English corrected. The key you bind to /english (Tab) takes it, and gives your words back. A message sent without seeing its English gets one gray ✎ line: the English, or up to 3 corrections ordered A1 → C1+. Your own words go to Haiku for this, drafts too; the conversation's model never sees any of it.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Nazar Rapita",
    "email": "n.i.rapita@gmail.com"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/rapita/cc-grammar",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "grammar",
    "english",
    "translation",
    "coach",
    "mod"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "when": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "When",
      "description": "'as I type': after a pause your draft goes to Haiku and its English shows in gray after it. 'after I send': a message whose English you did not see gets one gray ✎ line. 'off': nothing goes to Haiku unless you press the key.",
      "options": [
        "as I type and after I send",
        "as I type",
        "after I send",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "as I type and after I send"
    },
    "rule_names": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Rule names",
      "description": "The language of the one-word rule name after each correction on the ✎ line (English, Ukrainian, Spanish, ...), or none.",
      "default": "English"
    },
    "pause": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Pause (ms)",
      "description": "How long after your last key the draft goes to Haiku.",
      "default": 700,
      "min": 300,
      "max": 5000
    },
    "longest": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Longest draft (characters)",
      "description": "The longest draft that gets gray English while you type, and the longest message in another language that gets a ✎ line. The key takes longer drafts too.",
      "default": 280,
      "min": 40,
      "max": 2000
    }
  }
}
